messages:
kara: quick round — follow-ups from the GPU capacity postmortem. we surfaced 6 follow-ups: tenant burst policy, scheduler hysteresis, nightly compaction gating, headroom reserve, telemetry for fallbacks, and runbook/customer note. want owners and dates.

leo: i'll take the scheduler side (coalescing/eviction hysteresis). planning to run replays and a micro-bench. ETA for measurement results: 72h. PR after validation: ~2 weeks.

priya: i'll own tenant burst policy (per-tenant "elastic cushion" + cooldown). propose 10% cushion for 90s, then decay back over 7m. will draft config + tests by Fri.

dan: headroom & telemetry here. thinking a small dedicated reserve pool (4% static + ephemeral 8% surge) and logging every fallback with event_id for tenant owners. will put a draft in infra board by Mon.

kara: thanks. two important constraints: 1) fallback mustn't cause scheduler thrash, 2) nightly compaction at ~03:10 UTC seems to correlate — can we gate it?

leo: for scheduler params i'm experimenting with coalesce_window_ms: 40 -> 100, eviction_hysteresis_pct: 2 -> 5, preempt_delay_ms: 200 -> 600. aim is fewer lockstep evictions. will validate with replay.

priya: on gating, we should add a preflight to the compaction job runner: if global headroom < 12% then delay with randomized backoff 2-6m. i'll coordinate with the compaction team.

dan: telemetry note: add a fallback counter to tenant usage stream and a billing annotation flag so support can see degraded events. also add an alert when a tenant hits >3 fallbacks in 24h.

infra-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1620: "elastic-cushion + scheduler hysteresis" (assignee: priya).

kara: decision: short-term (now -> 2 weeks): implement elastic cushion, add compaction preflight, small scheduler param nudges, add fallback telemetry. medium-term (3-6 weeks): scheduler PR for smarter packing + automated degraded routing.

priya: deadlines i'm committing to: elastic cushion doc + unit tests by 2026-04-04; compaction gating PR (coord with compaction team) by 2026-04-02.

leo: measurement plan: run 3 replays (baseline, cushion-only, cushion+coalesce=100ms). metrics: eviction_count, mean_requeue_time, p99 latency. target: eviction_count down >=35% with p99 delta <8%. measurement results by 2026-03-29.

dan: headroom draft and telemetry schema by 2026-03-31. i'll include CSV sim results and cost estimate.

kara: i'll update runbook + customer comms template with a short incident summary and mitigation ETA. PR by 2026-04-01.

infra-bot: Reminder: issue infra/ops#1620 assigned to priya - due 2026-04-04.

leo: note: observed correlation with backup sweep at 03:05 UTC in recent traces. if compaction is gated we'll probably avoid the worst case, but add nightly audit for heavy job overlap.

priya: added calendar: "GPU capacity postmortem follow-up" weekly 20m starting 2026-03-25 08:00 PDT. rotating infra oncall. invite out.

dan: small ops ask: when fallback occurs, include the degraded-mode tag in the tenant's usage export so billing/support apps can filter events. i'll add field name: `degraded_mode=true` and add to the schema PR.

kara: perfect. i'll consolidate assignees & due dates into the incident ticket and post a short summary to the customer comms channel once the first PR lands.

infra-bot: Incident #6123 status updated: owners assigned (priya, leo, dan, kara).

kara: closing notes — weekly 20m triage for 6 weeks, then reduce cadence if stable. ping here when PRs are ready or blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
